Construction of Brgy. Buenlag FMR, Brgy. Buenlag, Mangatarem, Pangasinan
START: 15.8047319, 120.2548345
END: 15.8050199, 120.2610412
records.to: RETAIN
records.remarks:
There are two separate localities named Buenlag in Pangasinan: one located in the Municipality of Mangaldan and another in the Municipality of Mangatarem.

For the FY 2026 GAA project, a modification was proposed to correct its geographic coordinates, which currently point to Buenlag, Mangatarem, although the intended project location is Buenlag, Mangaldan. 

Meanwhile, under the FY 2027 NEP, the project in Buenlag, Mangatarem was included using the corrected location name and corresponding geographic coordinates.

This clarification ensures that the two projects refer to their respective intended locations and prevents potential duplication or misidentification.
